jobs.title: Klinikassistent til hårtransplantation / Clinical Assistant – Hair Restoration
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Private Clinic på Frederiksberg søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst klinikassistent til vores team.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt og omfatter primært praktisk og klinisk assistance i forbindelse med klinikkens behandlinger inden for hårtransplantation og hair restoration.

Arbejdsopgaverne omfatter blandt andet klargøring af behandlingsrum, instrumenter og udstyr, assistance før, under og efter hårtransplantationsbehandlinger, praktisk hjælp ved håndtering og klargøring af grafts efter oplæring og instruktion, modtagelse og forberedelse af patienter, patientvejledning før og efter behandling samt lettere dokumentation og administrative opgaver.

Vi forventer, at du er ansvarsbevidst, omhyggelig og struktureret, har gode samarbejdsevner og interesse for klinisk arbejde og patientkontakt. Du skal være indstillet på at lære nye procedurer og arbejdsmetoder og kunne arbejde både selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

Erfaring fra klinik, sundhedssektoren, kosmetiske behandlinger eller hårtransplantation er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Relevant oplæring vil blive tilbudt.

Ansættelse: Fuldtid, 37 timer ugentligt
Arbejdssted: Copenhagen Private Clinic, Frederiksberg
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Copenhagen Private Clinic.

Copenhagen Private Clinic in Frederiksberg is looking for a motivated and responsible Clinical Assistant to join our team.

The position is full-time, 37 hours per week, and primarily involves practical and clinical assistance in connection with the clinic’s hair transplantation and hair restoration treatments.

The main responsibilities include preparation of treatment rooms, instruments and equipment, assistance before, during and after hair transplantation procedures, practical assistance with handling and preparation of grafts following training and instruction, preparation and reception of patients, practical patient guidance before and after treatment, as well as basic documentation and administrative tasks.

We are looking for someone who is responsible, detail-oriented and well organised, with good teamwork skills and an interest in clinical work and patient care. You should be motivated to learn new procedures and working methods and be able to work both independently and as part of a team.

Previous experience from a clinic, healthcare, cosmetic treatments or hair transplantation is an advantage, but not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided.

Employment: Full-time, 37 hours per week
Workplace: Copenhagen Private Clinic, Frederiksberg, Denmark
Starting date: By agreement
Salary and employment conditions: According to qualifications and agreement.

Please send your application and CV to Copenhagen Private Clinic.

jobs.title: Hoivanantaja
jobs.description:
"Vuonna 2008 perustetun Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan visiona on muuttaa ikääntymisen kasvot tarjoamalla yksilöllisiä ja kiireettömiä koti- ja hoivapalveluita, jotka mahdollistavat ikäihmisen turvallisen kotona asumisen mahdollisimman pitkään. Palvelussamme korostuvat yksilöllisyys, luottamuksellisuus ja kumppanuus. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoiva toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, Uudellamaalla sekä Päijät-Hämeen, Pirkanmaan, Turun, Hämeenlinnan ja Oulun alueilla. Lisätietoa: www.KotonaAsuen.fi"

Nyt etsimme hoivanantajia asiakkaillemme Forssan alueelle.

Työ hoiva-alalla ikäihmisten parissa vaatii tekijältään aitoa välittämistä ja läsnäoloa. Haemme joukkoomme myötätuntoisia ja oikean arvomaailman omaavia henkilöitä.

Olet etsimämme henkilö, mikäli sinulla on intoa ja valmiuksia huolehtia senioreista heidän omissa kodeissaan. Etsimme myötätuntoisia, luotettavia ja sosiaalisia henkilöitä vahvistamaan hoivanantaja tiimiämme. Tutkintoja tai kokemusta tärkeämpänä arvostamme aitoa kykyä huolehtia toisista ihmisistä. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi.

Hoivanantajana parannat seniorin elämänlaatua ja avustat häntä toimimaan itsenäisesti. Työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia. Olet apuna senioreiden päivittäisessä elämässä mahdollistaen arjen sujuvuuden. Tehtäviisi voi kuulua seuranpidon ohella kodinhoidollisissa tehtävissä avustamista, kuten siivousta, ruoanlaittoa, pyykkihuoltoa. Asiakkaat tarvitsevat monesti myös ulkoilu, kauppa- ja asiointiavustusta, joissa pääset olemaan mukana. Asiakkaan henkilökohtainen hoiva kuten aamu- ja iltatoimissa avustaminen voi olla osa hoivanantajan työtä.

Edellytämme:

- Soveltuvuutta ja halua hoivatyöhön.

- Luotettavuutta ja joustavuutta.

- Myönteistä elämänasennetta ja sosiaalisuutta.

- Hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

- Tarkistamme työntekijän luottotiedot

- Lain sosiaali-ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023 §28 mukaisesti tehtävään otettavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

- Ilmoitathan suosittelijat työtehtävään.

- Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi.


Tarjoamme:

- Joustavat mahdollisuudet tehdä työtä haluamillasi työtunneilla.

- Itsenäisen, mielenkiintoisen ja erittäin palkitsevan työn.

- Kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään.

- Tutut, vakituiset ja sinulle valikoidut asiakkaat.

- Toimiston henkilökunnan tuen ja työnohjauksen.

- Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan.

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua yrityksen järjestämiin sisäisiin koulutuksiin.

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua yrityksen järjestämiin tiimitapaamisiin.


Työnhakeminen on helppoa - täytä pikahakemus osoitteessa: www.kotonaasuen.fi/tule-hoivanantajaksi, niin olemme sinuun pian yhteydessä!

Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuajan aikana ja paikat täyttyvät nopeasti, joten jätäthän hakemuksesi jo tänään!

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics
jobs.description:
About the position

Integreat - the Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at the University of Oslo invites applications for a doctoral research fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics. We seek a motivated researcher, who values collaboration, inclusivity, and impact, and who would like to contribute to a supportive, interdisciplinary research environment with strong focus on mentoring and career development.

Starting date upon agreement, and no later than 31 January 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at University of Oslo at Blindern, Oslo.

We welcome applicants with a strong background in machine learning and statistics, who are eager to contribute to cutting-edge methods for generating private and fair synthetic data with good utility. This project involves development of deep learning based synthetic data generators that obtain both good utility and protection of privacy, through tailored model approximation, as well as new measures of privacy and fairness to be used for assessing properties of synthetic generators, or in loss functions for training them. Further, the potentials and limitations of the developed approaches should be critically assessed regarding their implications for fairness, privacy, and utility. This project is at the intersection of machine learning, statistics and ethics.

This position is affiliated with the research group research group in Statistics and Data Science at the Department of Mathematics at University of Oslo, in close collaboration with the machine learning group at the Department of Informatics.


About Integreat

See the video for more information about Integreat.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-_I52cJHiW4About Integreat 

Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research Council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). This position is in Oslo.

Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore it is a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world. Integreat develops theories, methods, models, and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. We do this by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technology, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

The focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and therefore solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, statistics, data science, mathematics, or related field
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Employment and admission to the PhD programme are conditional upon successful completion of the Master's degree and submission of official documentation confirming that the degree has been awarded. Applicants who are in the final stages of completing their Master's degree may still apply.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with deep learning models
  • Strong background in programming
  • A keen interest in considering and discussing ethical aspects of the research projects
  • Experience with interdisciplinary work

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements: 

The norm is as follows:

  • the average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Supplementary Regulations at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences to the Regulations for the Degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo - The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


Personal skills

We are looking for candidates who are curious, open-minded, and motivated to learn. You should enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and be comfortable communicating your ideas clearly across disciplines. A collaborative spirit, a strong sense of responsibility, and a willingness to contribute to an inclusive and respectful research culture are essential.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

Integreat is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging, guided by our INTEGREAT principles (Integrity, Non discrimination, Tact, Environment, Gratitude, Respect, Empathy, Accountability, Transparency). We embed these values in practice through inclusive hiring and structured evaluations, targeted mentoring and career development, and flexible work arrangements and accommodations to ensure everyone can thrive and contribute.

We particularly welcome applications from women and gender minorities who are underrepresented in STEM, as well as applicants with immigrant backgrounds, disabilities, non linear career paths, or career breaks. We will take career interruptions and diverse career trajectories into account during evaluation.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.


We offer
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK 550 800 – 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A unique research environment with multiple opportunities to develop research themes at the forefront of modern science
  • A friendly, inclusive, and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives
  • Access to a strong network of top-level national and international collaborators
  • A reliable and generous pension agreement, along with strong public benefits
  • Comprehensive welfare schemes supporting both personal and professional well-being
  • Full access to public health services through membership in the National Insurance Scheme
  • A vibrant academic environment with an active and supportive research community
  • Structured career development programmes at the faculty level and an individual professional development plan throughout the postdoctoral period
  • Mentoring and support structures tailored to early-career researchers
  • Flexible working conditions, with understanding for different life situations and family responsibilities
  • Research mobility funds supporting short research stays and international collaboration
  • Family-friendly surroundings in Oslo and Tromsø, with rich opportunities for culture, nature, and outdoor activities
  • A clear institutional commitment to gender equality and diversity, with dedicated initiatives and networks for women in science

Integreat provides a researcher training programme, INTREF - the Integreat Young Researchers’ Forum - a fellow driven initiative offering scientific training, transferable skills workshops, mentorship, research visits, and career development support.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter – describe your motivation for pursuing a PhD at Integreat and in Norway, with particular emphasis on your research interests and academic achievements to date relevant for this position and the project
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • If relevant you may attach Master thesis or a draft of your thesis
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Documentation of English proficiency

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

Integreat – Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning - Integreat is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world.

Integreat develops theories, methods, models and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. This will be done by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technologies, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

Focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and by this solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.

jobs.title: Sanitør til løsøre | Hjælp os med at passe på det, der betyder noget
jobs.description:
Det er ikke bare ting

Når en kunde bliver ramt af brand, vand eller en anden skade, kan hjemmets eller virksomhedens indbo også blive berørt.

Møbler, billeder, bøger, tøj og personlige ejendele kan ved første øjekast ligne almindelige ting – men for kunden kan de have stor både praktisk og personlig værdi.

Derfor kræver arbejdet med løsøre noget særligt.

Hos Ocab søger vi nu en sanitør, som har lyst til at arbejde med håndtering, rengøring og behandling af kundernes indbo og løsøre – både ude hos kunderne og på vores vaskelinje.

Om jobbet

Som sanitør til løsøre følger du kundens ejendele gennem forskellige dele af processen.

Det kan begynde ude på et skadested, hvor indbo skal sorteres, registreres, pakkes og transporteres. Andre dage arbejder du på vores vaskelinje med rengøring og behandling af løsøre, så mest muligt kan reddes og leveres tilbage til kunden.

Det kræver ikke bare praktisk sans. Det kræver også, at du arbejder systematisk, omhyggeligt og respektfuldt med de ting, du får mellem hænderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Håndtering af indbo og løsøre efter brand-, vand- og andre skader

  • Sortering og registrering af kundernes ejendele

  • Pakning, mærkning og klargøring til transport og opbevaring

  • Rengøring og behandling af løsøre

  • Arbejde på vores vaskelinje

  • Flytning og håndtering af møbler og øvrigt indbo

  • Arbejde ude hos kunder i forbindelse med skadesager

  • Dokumentation af det udførte arbejde

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere gennem hele forløbet

Vi forestiller os, at du

Til denne stilling leder vi først og fremmest efter en person, der kan lide at gøre tingene grundigt og ordentligt.

Du forstår, at du arbejder med andre menneskers ejendele, og du behandler dem med den samme omhu, som du selv ville ønske.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Er omhyggelig og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på de ting, du håndterer

  • Har lyst til både praktisk arbejde og mere systematiske opgaver

  • Trives med at arbejde på vores vaskelinje såvel som ude hos kunderne

  • Er i god fysisk form, da flytning og håndtering af indbo kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til teamet

  • Møder kunderne ordentligt og med forståelse for den situation, de står i

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Erfaring fra skadeservice, rengøring, flyttebranchen, lager eller lignende praktisk arbejde kan være en fordel, men det vigtigste er din tilgang til arbejdet og din lyst til at lære.

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader. Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En varieret hverdag med både arbejde på vores vaskelinje og ude hos kunderne

  • Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Et arbejde, hvor omhu og kvalitet gør en reel forskel

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Ingen obligatorisk deltagelse i vagtordningen

Arbejdssted: Ocab Farum, Rugmarken 36, 3520 Farum

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

Har du lyst til at blive en del af holdet?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Casper Schiermer på tlf. +45 61 56 59 02.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | Bliv en del af Ocab Holbæk
jobs.description:
En hverdag, hvor der er brug for dig

Når en kunde bliver ramt af en vand-, brand- eller skimmelskade, er en hurtig og professionel indsats vigtig. Hos Ocab rykker vi ud, begrænser skaden og hjælper kunden videre – og som sanitør bliver du en vigtig del af den indsats.

Til vores afdeling i Holbæk søger vi nu en sanitør, som trives med en aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag, tager ansvar og har lyst til at blive en del af et hold med dygtige kolleger.

Nogle dage følger planen. Andre dage gør den ikke. Det er en del af jobbet – og derfor skal du kunne bevare overblikket og være klar til at træde til, når der er brug for dig.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab arbejder du med mange forskellige typer skadeserviceopgaver hos både private, virksomheder og professionelle kunder.

Det er et praktisk og fysisk job. Du kan blandt andet komme til at flytte og håndtere kundernes indbo og løsøre, arbejde med nedrivning og sanering samt løse industriopgaver og opgaver i højden.

Du arbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med kolleger og projektledere. Uanset opgaven er målet det samme: at levere et professionelt stykke arbejde og møde kunden ordentligt i en situation, der ofte er både uventet og vanskelig.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Håndtering og flytning af indbo og løsøre

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

  • Industriopgaver

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

  • Deltagelse i vagtordning

Vi forestiller os, at du

jobs.title: Palvelukotivastaava, Kurjenpolven palvelukoti
jobs.description:
Tule johtamaan arkea, jolla on merkitys.

**Etsimme nyt palvelukotivastaavaa Kurjenpolven palvelukotiin Polvijärvelle.**

Kurjenpolven palvelukoti tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 12 aikuiselle tukea tarvitsevalle henkilölle, joiden tuen tarpeen taustalla on esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä jokaisen arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää – meillä koti on koti.

**Tehtäväsi**

Palvelukotivastaavana johdat yksikön toimintaa ja toimit tiimin esihenkilönä. Varmistat, että asukkaiden arki on turvallista, yksilöllistä ja oman näköistä. Pidät huolta siitä, että toiminta on laadukasta, vaikuttavaa ja taloudellisesti kestävää. Olet läsnä palvelukodin arjessa; noin puolet työstäsi on asiakastyötä ja puolet hallinnollista johtamistyötä.

Palvelukotivastaavana olet arjen johtaja ja mahdollistaja: pidät suunnan kirkkaana, mutta teet työtä lähellä ihmisiä ja tiimiä. Arvostamme vuorovaikutustaitoja, rohkeutta tehdä päätöksiä ja halua johtaa työtä niin, että laatu, hyvinvointi ja muutoskyky kulkevat rinnakkain.

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- työvuorosuunnittelu ja työsuhdeasiat kuten rekrytointi ja perehdytys

- omavalvonnan, lääkehoidon ja turvallisuuden toteutumisen varmistaminen

- yksikön talouden suunnittelu ja seuranta

- yhteistyö omaisten, hyvinvointialueiden ja muiden kumppaneiden kanssa

- yksikön toiminnan kehittäminen yhdessä asukkaiden ja tiimin kanssa.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa sosiaali- ja terveysalalta (esimerkiksi sosionomi AMK tai sairaanhoitaja AMK), Valvira-rekisteröintiä ja voimassa olevaa sote-ammattikorttia

- Riittävää kokemusta vammaisalasta

- Vahvaa vammaispalvelulain (675/2023) tuntemusta

- Johtamisosaamista opintojen tai työkokemuksen kautta

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ennen työn aloitusta.


**Miksi valita meidät?**

Honkalampi-säätiö on yhteiskunnallinen yritys, joka mahdollistaa hyvää elämää ihmisille, jotka tarvitsevat tukea arjessaan. Kehitämme palveluja, joissa laatu, osallisuus ja vastuullisuus kulkevat aidosti rinnakkain. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen.

Honkalammen asumispalveluiden esihenkilötiimi kohtaa toisiaan säännöllisesti ja arjen tuki ja neuvot ovat helposti saatavilla. Honkalammella johtajuus tarkoittaa läsnäoloa ja muutoskykyä – halua kehittää toimintaa niin, että laatu ja hyvinvointi pysyvät tasapainossa. Arvomme, vastuu, rohkeus ja kekseliäisyys, näkyvät arjen teoissa joka päivä.

Hyvinvointiasi tukevat laaja työterveyshuolto, liukuva työaika, osittainen etätyömahdollisuus ja ePassin kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointietu. Palkkaus määräytyy yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:in mukaan kokemuksen ja tehtävän vaativuuden perusteella (palkkaluokka G27 + tehtäväkohtainen palkanosa).

**Lisätiedot ja haku**

Jätäthän hakemuksesi 27.9.2026 mennessä osoitteeseen: rekrytointi@hl-s.fi (Hakuaikaa jatkettu, aiemmin lähetetyt hakemukset huomioidaan haussa)

**Toimithan nopeasti, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

saila.kosunen@hl-s.fi | 0400 377228

Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.

Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

jobs.title: Développeur C# confirmé H/F - ASP.NET / React
jobs.description:
À propos de nous

E-finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans les solutions de gestion financière et de trésorerie. Nos solutions permettent aux entreprises d'optimiser la gestion de leurs flux financiers, d'améliorer leur visibilité sur leur trésorerie et de renforcer leur performance financière.

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre l'aventure et laisser une vraie empreinte sur ce que nous construisons.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur. Vous n'arrivez pas sur un projet figé : vous participez activement à la refonte de nos applications et à la définition de la manière dont elles doivent évoluer. Vos idées et votre esprit d'initiative sont attendus, pas seulement votre code.
  • De l'autonomie et de la confiance. Vous travaillez en petite équipe soudée (un Lead Tech, trois développeurs, un Product Owner), avec la liberté d'organiser votre travail et de proposer vos propres solutions techniques.
  • Des perspectives d'évolution concrètes. En rejoignant une équipe en croissance sur un produit stratégique, vous avez l'opportunité de faire grandir vos responsabilités techniques (architecture, mentorat, choix technologiques) au fil du temps.
  • De la flexibilité. Organisation de travail flexible et équilibre vie pro / vie perso respecté, dans un environnement où l'on juge sur les résultats plutôt que sur la présence.
  • Des sujets qui comptent. Modernisation d'un legacy réel (.NET Framework 3.5/4.8 vers .NET 8), dette technique à réduire, nouveaux features à concevoir de zéro : de quoi élargir votre expertise technique en continu.
  • Un process rapide et direct. un premier échange avec notre Lead Tech (en visio), puis une case study en présentiel avec la Directrice d'E-finances.

Vos missions

  • Développer :  concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir des applications en C#.
  • Moderniser :  participer activement à la refonte technique de nos solutions et à la migration vers les technologies récentes.
  • Réduire la dette technique :  contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre codebase et proposer des solutions.
  • Collaborer en agilité :  participer aux rituels agiles (sprints, daily stand-ups, weekly meetings) au sein d'une équipe où la communication est directe et fluide.
  • Garantir la qualité :  assurer la qualité du code via des tests unitaires et les bonnes pratiques de développement.

Compétences principales requises

  • C# :  minimum 4 ans d'expérience.
  • .NET Framework 3.5 / 4.8 à .NET 8 :  maîtrise de ces technologies.
  • ASP.NET (Razor et jQuery) ou React :  expertise dans l'une de ces stacks.
  • SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle :  maîtrise de SQL et expérience avec au moins l'un des trois SGBD.
  • Git :  gestion des versions avec Git, Pull Requests et Code Review.
  • Tests unitaires :  expérience avec les TU pour garantir la qualité du code.
  • Agilité :  connaissance des pratiques agiles et des méthodologies associées.
  • CI/CD.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement.
  • Basé(e) à moins d'une heure de Nantes.
  • Français et anglais courants.
  • Esprit d'initiative et mentalité « doer » :  à l'aise pour proposer, tester et itérer plutôt qu'attendre des consignes.
  • Adaptabilité :  capacité à monter rapidement en compétence sur de nouvelles technologies et à comprendre les enjeux métier.
  • Autonomie et goût du collectif :  capable de travailler aussi bien seul qu'en équipe.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en résolution de problèmes.

 

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même, nous discutons volontiers de votre profil.

Als Verzorgende IG via detachering spring jij in bij verschillende zorginstellingen: van verpleeghuizen en thuiszorg tot revalidatiecentra. Geen dag is hetzelfde! Je ondersteunt cliënten met hun dagelijkse zorg, voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en zorgt voor een warme en veilige omgeving.

Het is natuurlijk belangrijk om een vertrouwd gezicht te zijn voor de bewoners. Daarom duurt een detachering minimaal 2 tot 3 maanden, maar het kan ook een half jaar of zelfs een jaar zijn. In die tijd draai je volledig mee in het team. Na deze periode ga je door naar een nieuwe, uitdagende opdracht. Je kan kiezen voor afwisseling tussen verschillende doelgroepen, hebt de mogelijkheid om een opdracht te verlengen wanneer deze goed bevalt of je kiest voor een doelgroep die jou het meeste aanspreekt.


Bij Medicalhunt sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt een vaste contactpersoon en we bieden je persoonlijke begeleiding en ondersteuning, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het beste doet: zorgen voor anderen!


Wat maakt detacheren nou zo leuk?

Afwisseling: Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je werkt. Dit geeft je vrijheid in je werk, maar zorgt er ook voor dat je een goede werk-privé balans kan behouden;

Zekerheid: Een arbeidscontract bij ons voor een x aantal uren in de week, mét de flexibiliteit van detachering;

Ontwikkeling: Wij investeren in jouw groei met trainingen en opleidingen;

Teamspirit: Ook al werk je op verschillende locaties, je maak echt deel uit van team Medicalhunt. We staan altijd voor je klaar en zetten jouw werkgeluk op nummer 1!

Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

A Control Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and support of industrial control and automation systems for large‑scale capital projects. jobs.title: Tips for Candidates
jobs.description:
This document has been put together to help you prepare for your arrival in the Netherlands. You are
going to work in the Netherlands, and so below are some tips to help you prepare as well as possible.
We advise you to ask your future employer as many questions as possible to ensure you are well
prepared when you start work.
Description of the agricultural sector
• Much of the work is done outside, in all kinds of weather (rain and hot sunshine). Ask your
employer for any photos and/or films of the work you will be doing. Tip: search Google and
YouTube for videos / photos of the work involved.
• Work in the agricultural sector is seasonal and depends on the weather. Favourable weather
conditions can boost production within a short space of time. This will result in a lot of work
and you may be able to work more (extra) hours. It's just as likely that, due to the weather,
production levels do not rise as quickly as expected, and that you consequently work fewer
hours than usual. In that case, your employer may give you other work to do.
• Agricultural businesses are often located in remote areas, some distance from the nearest
large town. Facilities and amenities such as a supermarket or train station will often not be
close by.
• Accomodation varies from business to business and will often be located close to the
field/building you are working in. The agricultural businesses provide accommodation for their
workers, and this could be on a campsite, a container home, shed, caravan, house, etc.

Executive Assistant – Corporate Governance & Board Support (M/F/X)

About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission

As an Executive Assistant reporting to the General Secretary, you will serve as the primary point of coordination for the CEO's office, managing the executive diary, organising leadership meetings and ensuring seamless communication between the CEO, internal teams and external stakeholders. You will also play a central role in corporate governance by coordinating Board of Managers meetings and General Assemblies and maintaining compliance with Luxembourg's legal obligations.
You will combine high-level administrative expertise with strong organisational skills to support the agency's leadership team in delivering on Luxinnovation's mission.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire: Representing the leadership and enhancing institutional visibility
• Welcome and accompany VIP visitors, ensuring a professional and seamless experience
• Coordinate internal and external events organised by the CEO's office and the broader leadership team
• Prepare briefing documents, background notes and speaking points for the CEO's external engagements
• Support the CEO's institutional representation at high-level meetings and conferences

Assess & Accelerate: Driving operational excellence across the executive office
• Manage the CEO's diary: schedule appointments, meetings and professional travel (transport, accommodation, programmes, visa formalities where required)
• Process and validate travel-related expense reports
• Collect, consolidate and track information for the CEO on ongoing projects, events and pending requests
• Organise semi-annual and annual performance review meetings between the CEO and direct reports
• Manage and validate leave and telework requests from the CEO's direct reports
• Ensure administrative follow-up: filing, archiving and document management

Connect: Facilitating seamless communication and cross-departmental coordination

• Vous qualifiez les project briefs entrants, échangez avec les chefs / cheffes de projet métier pour clarifier objectifs, enjeux, urgence, dépendances, critères de succès et lien avec la stratégie, et évaluez les impacts IT : ressources, compétences, technologies, budget, charge RUN/BUILD, risques et dépendances
• Vous coordonnez les échanges avec les experts techniques, unités IT et bureaux d'études afin de consolider une vision réaliste, sans vous substituer à l'expertise technique
• Vous produisez un aperçu projet exploitable pour le PMO, le management IT, la gouvernance et les sponsors. Vous alimentez le Project Board avec des informations cohérentes, lisibles et traçables, afin de faciliter l'organisation interne, la priorisation et les arbitrages IT
• Vous réalisez des analyses coûts/bénéfices, fiabilisez les éléments financiers et préparez les informations nécessaires à une décision Go / No Go éclairée, en transparence sur les coûts, bénéfices et impacts

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de bachelor (bac+3) en informatique
• Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle similaire d'au moins 5 ans
• Vous maîtrisez les langues anglaise et française aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Les langues luxembourgeoise et allemande sont considérées comme un atout
• Vous disposez d'une bonne connaissance de la gouvernance des projets IT et des principes de pilotage de portefeuille (priorisation, arbitrage, décisions Go / No Go)
• Vous maîtrisez le cycle de vie d'un projet IT, depuis le cadrage et l'analyse jusqu'au lancement, à la réalisation et à la mise en production
• Vous comprenez le fonctionnement d'un service Informatique, notamment les rôles du PMO, des unités RUN et BUILD ainsi que des experts techniques
• Vous maîtrisez les méthodes d'analyse et de qualification des demandes, incluant la clarification des besoins, l'identification des enjeux et l'analyse des risques
• Vous connaissez les principes de planification et de gestion des capacités IT, notamment en matière de ressources, de compétences et de dépendances

Description:

EU Process Engineer AMZL, Standards & Innovation

Description

This role can be based anywhere in the EU with travel up to 20%. Corporate office locations are in : Munich, Berlin, Madrid, Barcelona, Milan, Paris, Luxembourg, London.
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation. Amazon Logistics aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible.
The European Amazon Logistics team is seeking an experienced, innovative, hands on and customer obsessed Sr Process Engineer to drive standardization and innovation in physical infrastructure, layout and material flow across our Last Mile delivery network. As a member of the EU Amazon Logistics Engineering team you will be responsible for producing and refining process standards, developing new products and processes, building on current best practices for physical infrastructure and designing Amazon Logistics equipment that is used across the EU network and beyond. Infrastructure you develop will always be produced to meet safety, customer experience, capacity, quality and cost goals. You will act as a key point of contact for your area of responsibility within the EU Amazon Logistics processes, frequently partnering with leaders in the field, as well as other operational support functions and your worldwide counterparts. The core process infrastructure ownership element of this role spans Delivery Station under-the-roof and On-the-Road operations.

This position requires deep customer focus, strong autonomy and exceptional project management skills. It will involve regular communication with executors and project sponsors at both the European and worldwide level, and requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable partnering across functional business and technical teams. To be successful in this role, you need to pair strong analytical skills and a data-driven outlook with strong intuition.

• Lead the design and development of new processes, equipment, process-flows, Infrastructure across all processpaths with AMZL
• Optimize existing processes/equipment and drive expansion of new processes/equipment from concept to deployment
• Own and drive programs that improve capacity, productivity, safety and Ergonomics within Delivery Stations
• Author and chair reports/ business case reviews to document project status and changes with senior leadership

• Creates strategy for long term roadmap

A day in the life

Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organization and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short, mid and long term decisions that have impact on a large scale across the AMZL network. You would also be working with partners from Operations, Process Improvement, Health and Safety, Ergonomics, Finance, Procurement and external vendors to design and deploy new equipment and processes for the multiple process paths in AMZL Delivery Stations. You will put in place mechanisms to track project success, measure KPIs and build reports to provide visibility to senior leaders across the organization. Finally, you will have fun doing everything listed above.

Our team partners closely with AMZL Operations and support functions to identify, design and develop best-in-class process infrastructure and process layouts, and deliver them as EU AMZL network standards. Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

• Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

Description:

Investigation Specialist II , Global Product Verification (GPV), Perfect Order Experience
Job ID: 10529077 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

The Global Product Verification (GPV) team is Amazon's premier product authentication and verification team, protecting marketplace integrity through comprehensive product verification systems. We specialize in seller verification, strategic product procurement, and implementing comprehensive authentication standards. By focusing on PQ metrics, we tackle critical challenges including counterfeit prevention, expiration compliance, and product condition accuracy. Through collaborative partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, we ensure Amazon remains the most trusted destination for authentic products worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

As a GPV Investigator, you will be part of a team responsible for inspecting and auditing products sold by third-party sellers on Amazon.com store for various defects impacting Amazon's customers. You will leverage various tools, systems, standard operating procedures and job aids to assist in identifying product quality defects across a range of programs.  The below are key areas of responsibility of this role:

• You will be expected to meet weekly investigative targets established by leadership.
• You be expected to meet weekly quality assurance goals as defined by leadership.
• You will also identify opportunities to improve our internal processes and procedures to help streamline our day-to-day operations.
• You will work closely with leadership and Sr. Investigators in identifying tends and themes to assist our internal customers, Product Quality stakeholders, in driving upstream improvements in Seller quality metrics, and overall cx.

A day in the life

As a GPV Investigator 2, here's what your typical day-to-day activities look like:

• Conduct product investigations
• Follow established investigation procedures
• Focus on low to medium complexity issues
• Update investigation tracking systems
• Attend team meetings

The role focuses on building expertise in Global Product Verification (GPV) investigation techniques, which involves verifying that products meet global quality standards, analyzing product deviations, conducting product investigations across international markets, and contributing to compliance and the overall quality system.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience working with computer and web based tools
• Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
• Experience in data analysis and leveraging analytics to make decisions

Description:

Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
• Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
• Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes.
• Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
• Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
• Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.
EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment
• Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
• Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
• Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
• Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.
Automation Hardware Integration
• Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
• Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
• Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
• Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.
Materials Characterization & Testing
• Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies.
• Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
• Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
• Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.
Specifications & Quality
• Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
• Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
• Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards.
• Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.
Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration
• Work directly with EU-based paper mills, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new paper-based packaging materials.
• Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
• Guide suppliers on process optimization—from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations—to achieve target material properties and consistency.
• Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.
Cross-Functional Partnership
• Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
• Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
• Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements (REACH, EU PPWR, CEFLEX).
• Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
• Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
• Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
• Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
• Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
• Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.
This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.
Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.
Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.
