jobs.title: Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
Job ID: 10526664 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?
We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.
Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

• Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.
• Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.
• Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.
• Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.
• Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.
• Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.
• Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.
• Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.
• Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About the team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.
Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in program or project management
• Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
• Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
• Experience in Supply Chain Management
• Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
• Experience leading process improvements
• AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
• Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
• Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech
Job ID: 10522151 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promise, across hundreds of millions of packages daily? SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the science behind these decisions. We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Luxembourg (alternatively: Barcelona, or London). You will design and build optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at scale from real-time order assignment and multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to capacity-aware control systems that steer millions of shipments per hour toward operational plans.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization models (MIP, heuristics, decomposition) that solve large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

• PhD
• Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
• Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Unix/Linux
• Experience in professional software development

Für unseren Kunden – einen führenden Anbieter im digitalen Vertriebsumfeld – suchen wir motivierte Digital Sales Representatives (m/w/d) mit sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnissen für den Standort Krakau, Polen.

Sie möchten Teil eines dynamischen Vertriebsteams sein, das internationale Kunden betreut und innovative cloudbasierte Produkte und Dienstleistungen vertreibt? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Aufbau und Pflege eines gesunden Vertriebspipelines zur Zielerreichung
- Aktive Ansprache und Betreuung von kleinen bis mittelständischen Unternehmen sowie Agenturen und Entscheidungsträgern auf C-Level
- Beratung zu digitalen Lösungen und cloudbasierten Produkten
- Erstellung von Angeboten, Preisverhandlungen und Abschluss von Verträgen
- Erkennen von Verkaufschancen und Umgang mit Einwänden
- Markt- und Produkttrends verfolgen und vertrieblich nutzen

Ihr Profil:

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2)
- Mindestens 1 Jahr nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung (B2B oder B2C)
- Kommunikationsstärke und Verhandlungsgeschick
- Erste Kenntnisse im Bereich cloudbasierter Software von Vorteil
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken und Freude am aktiven Kundenkontakt
- Umzugsbereitschaft nach Krakau, falls derzeit nicht vor Ort

Das wird Ihnen geboten:

- Umzugspaket für den Standortwechsel nach Krakau (inkl. Unterstützung bei Anreise und Unterkunft)
- Private medizinische Versorgung (inkl. Zahnpflege und Brillenrückerstattung)
- Multisportkarte zur Nutzung von Fitnessstudios und Freizeiteinrichtungen
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und zusätzliche Urlaubstage
- Jubiläumsprämien und Leistungsboni
- Sprachkurs-Zuschüsse sowie Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen im Bereich Vertrieb
- Internationale Teamkultur in einem wachsenden Umfeld mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Die Bewerbung und Kommunikation können auf Deutsch erfolgen.

Bitte beachten: Diese Stelle wird über unsere Plattform veröffentlicht – bei Klick auf "Jetzt bewerben" werden Sie direkt zur Anzeige auf unserem Job-Portal weitergeleitet.

jobs.title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/POMOĆNICA U NASTAVI
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 99. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnim i srednjim školama (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23), članka 21. i 22. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23), te članka 3. Pravilnika o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima (Narodne novine, broj 85/24) Osnovna škola „Drago Gervais“ Brešca, Brešca 6, 51213 Jurdani, tel. 051 279 229 dana 14.09.2026. objavljuje:

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

1. Pomoćnik u nastavi u Osnovnoj školi „Drago Gervais“ Brešca

- 1 (jedan) izvršitelj/ica na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme, 27 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena.

Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme za školsku godinu 2026./2027. do 31.8.2027. godine.

Mjesto rada : Brešca

Uvjeti:

  • najmanje završena četvrta srednja škola
  • završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi ili edukacije za pomoćnika u trajanju od najmanje 20 sati ako je stečena do 1. srpnja 2024. godine.
  • protiv osobe nije pokrenut kazneni postupak ili koja je pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnim i srednjim školama (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23) i članka 23. Zakona o asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23).

Pomoćnik u nastavi ne može pružati potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa svom članu obitelji, osim kada na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovne ustanove nije moguće zaposliti pomoćnika u nastavi, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju.

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.

Uz prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:

  1. životopis (vlastoručno potpisan, navedeni podatci o iskustvu u radu s djecom s teškoćama – naziv institucije/udruge/tvrtke te trajanje),
  2. dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (preslika diplome ili potvrda o stečenoj stručnoj spremi),
  3. dokaz o državljanstvu,
  4. potvrda o završenom programu edukacije odraslih odnosno edukacije za pomoćnika u nastavi,
  5. uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),

  1. dokaz da kandidatu nije pravomoćno izrečena prekršajno pravna sankcija za nasilje u obitelji (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  2. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od dana objave natječaja).

Način dostave prijava: Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se osobno ili putem pošte na adresu Škole: Osnovna škola „Drago Gervais“ Brešca, Brešca 6, 51213 Jurdani s naznakom: „NATJEČAJ ZA POMOĆNIKA U NASTAVI – 27 SATI“.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnim stranicama https://os-dgervais-jurdani.skole.hr/ i oglasnoj ploči školske ustanove.

Osoba koja ne podnese pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava propisane uvjete iz natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i ne obavještava se o razlozima zašto se ne smatra kandidatom natječaja.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine, broj 82/08. i 69/17.) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve propisane dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom

102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17., 98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj u kojoj se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rada i članovima njihovih obitelji, a koji su navedeni na mrežnim stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za% 20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-

%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/2021) uz prijavu na natječaj u kojoj se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a koji su navedeni na mrežnim stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za% 20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-

%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s

člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti civilnih i vojnih invalida rata (NN br.33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) dužan je uz

prijavu priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i potvrdu o statusu vojnog/civilnog invalida rata i dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji je stekao obrazovnu kvalifikaciju izvan Republike Hrvatske, a zapošljava se u reguliranoj profesiji u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja u Republici Hrvatskoj (nastavnik, strukovni učitelj, suradnik u nastavi, stručni suradnik u školskoj ustanovi) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj priložiti rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Ministarstvo znanosti i obrazovanja sukladno Zakonu o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija (NN 82/15, 70/19, 47/20).

Kandidati koji su svoju obrazovnu kvalifikaciju stekli izvan Republike Hrvatske, a zapošljavaju se u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja na radnom mjestu koje nije na popisu reguliranih profesija, dužni su dostaviti dokumentaciju sukladno Zakonu o priznavanju i vrednovanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija (NN 69/22).

Vrednovanje kandidata: Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, te čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune provest će se vrednovanje kandidata kroz usmeni razgovor (intervju).

Popis kandidata koji se pozivaju na intervju te mjesto i točan termin objavit će se u roku sedam dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj na mrežnoj stranici škole https://os-dgervais-jurdani.skole.hr/ u izborniku pod nazivom „Natječaji i ponude“, podizbornik „Natječaji za zapošljavanje“. Poziv će se dostaviti i na elektroničku poštu kandidata.

Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj koje imenuje ravnatelj, provest će usmeni razgovor (intervju) s kandidatima.

Kandidati su obvezni pristupiti postupku vrednovanja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi razgovoru, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj.

Obavijest o rezultatu ovog natječaja s imenom i prezimenom odabranog kandidata, škola će objaviti na svojim mrežnim stranicama https://os-dgervais-jurdani.skole.hr/ u izborniku pod nazivom „Natječaji i ponude“, podizbornik „Natječaji za zapošljavanje“., u roku 15 dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata, te će se objavom rezultata natječaja smatrati da su svi kandidati obaviješteni i neće biti pojedinačno pisano obavještavani.

Iznimno od navedenog, ako se na natječaj prijavi jedan ili više kandidata za koje se utvrdi da se osnovano pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, sve se kandidate izvješćuje istim tekstom obavijesti o rezultatima natječaja pisanom poštanskom pošiljkom, pri čemu se kandidate koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima izvješćuje pisanom preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom s povratnicom.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni s javnom objavom osobnih podataka (imena i prezimena) na mrežnim stranicama škole u svrhu poziva na razgovor. Suglasni su javnom objavom osobnih podataka (ime, prezime, titula) na mrežnoj stranici škole, u svrhu obavještavanja o rezultatima natječaja. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Školi da može prikupljati i obrađivati ​​osobne podatke kandidata iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, broj 42/18.). Kandidati su upoznati da prijave na natječaj Škola čuva i nakon isteka natječaja sukladno Posebnom popisu arhivskog i registraturnog gradiva s rokovima čuvanja i njegovim kasnijim izmjenama i dopunama.

Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe.

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje na mrežnim stanicama i oglasnoj ploči škole 14.9.2026.

KLASA: 112-04/26-01/4

URBROJ: 2156-25-01-26-1

Brešca, 14.9.2026.

jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23 dalje: ZOOOSŠ) i članka 3. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj školi Jelkovec, raspisuje se N A T J E Č A J za radno mjesto NASTAVNIK/CA STRUČNIH PREDMETA ELEKTROTEHNIKE I RAČUNALSTVA – 1 izvršitelj (m/ž), na određeno puno radno vrijeme (40 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena), zamjena za djelatnika koji obavlja dužnost ravnatelja uz probni rad 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Srednja škola Jelkovec, Vladimira Stahuljaka 1, Sesvete, a po potrebi temeljem pisane odluke ravnatelja i izvan sjedišta škole.
  • Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno Zakonu o radu (NN 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23 i 64/23) moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete prema članku 105. i 106. ZOOOSŠ-a i prema Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu (NN 1/96, 80/99)Ostali uvjeti utvrđeni Nastavnim planovima i programima te Kurikulumom za pojedini predmet. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu, kandidati trebaju dostaviti:

  • domovnicu ili elektronički zapis iz knjige državljana
  • potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupka za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od dana objave natječaja
  • potvrda o evidentiranom radnom stažu (elektronički zapis o radno-pravnom statusu, ne starije od dana objave natječaja)
  • privolu za obradu osobnih podataka dostupnu na mrežnim stranicama škole Isprave mogu biti priložene u neovjerenoj preslici, s potrebom dostave izvornih dokumenata na zahtjev Škole. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Kandidat/kinja koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 127/17., 98/19., 84/21 i 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ ODGOJITELJICA U  PODRUČNOM ODJELU BRDOVEC
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju ( NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) i članka 49. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Mali kaj (KLASA: 601-02/23-01,URBROJ: 2140-49- 601-02/23-01),Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Mali kaj na svojoj 08. Sjednici održanoj dana 10.09.2026.godine, raspisuje

NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto ODGOJITELJ/ ODGOJITELJICA u Područnom odjelu Brdovec

1. ODGOJITELJ

· 3 izvršitelja M/Ž - rad na nedređeno puno radno vrijeme

2. UVJETI:

· sukladno Zakonu o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, br.NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) i Pravilniku o vrsti stručne spreme stručnih djelatnika te vrsti i stupnju stručne spreme ostalih djelatnika u dječjem vrtiću (Narodne novine, br. 133/97)

Posebni uvjeti:

- da osoba nije pravomoćno osuđena ili da se protiv nje ne vodi postupak sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju

Prednost:

- položen stručni ispit,

- 1 godina radnog iskustva,

Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijem u radni odnos:

- punoljetnost,

- zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.

Dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta dostavit će izabrani kandidat po dostavljenoj obavijesti o izboru ukoliko se prvi put zapošljava.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu zamolbu - prijavu na natječaj, kandidati/kinje su obvezni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

· životopis (s posebnim osvrtom na dosadašnji rad u struci);

· dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika domovnice ili osobne iskaznice);

· dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (preslika diplome);

· dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu (preslika svjedožbe);

· potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o podacima o radnom stažu evidentiranim u bazi podataka HZMO, ne stariju od dana objave ovog natječaja;

· potvrda predškolske ustanove ili drugog poslodavca odnosno preslika ugovora o radu (koja mora sadržavati vrstu poslova koju je obavljao i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove) ukoliko do sada nije bio zaposlenik DV Mali kaj;

· uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko djelo iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26) izdanu u svrhu zapošljavanja u dječjem vrtiću koja ne smije biti starija od datuma objave natječaja;

· uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko djelo iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) u istu svrhu i s istim rokovima;

· potvrdu Centra za socijalnu skrb (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) u istu svrhu i s istim rokovima;

· izjava kandidata o nepostojanju zapreka iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (vlastoručno potpisana).

· potvrdu prethodnog poslodavca o razlogu prestanka Ugovora o radu (ukoliko je kandidat trenutno bez zaposlenja).

Sukladno članku 13. stavak 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu prijaviti kandidati oba spola.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat/kinja koji/a ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje tog prava, dužan/a je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i rješenje/potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka) te dokaz da je nezaposlen/a (uvjerenje ili evidencijski list Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje).

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17 i 98/19), dužan/a je pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. navedenog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja, na poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf

Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj.

Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Mali kaj

Ivana Gorana Kovačića 13

49000 Krapina

(Za natječaj – odgajatelj, NE OTVARAJ) ili osobno u tajništvu u PO Laduč.

Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja će biti pozvani na razgovor (intervju).

O terminima razgovora kandidati će biti obaviješteni najmanje tri dana prije održavanja.

Odluka o odabiru kandidata temeljem natječaja objaviti će se na mrežnim stranicama Dječjeg vrtića Mali kaj i oglasnim pločama Vrtića osam (8) dana od dana donošenja .

Nakon izvršenog natječaja ne mora se izvršiti izbor te se u tom slučaju donosi odluka o poništenju natječaja.

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Vrtića dana 14.09.2026. godine i traje do 22.09.2026. godine.

Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26) izdanu u svrhu zapošljavanja u dječjem vrtiću koja ne smije biti starija od datuma objave natječaja; · uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko djelo iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) u istu svrhu i s istim rokovima; · potvrdu Centra za socijalnu skrb (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Sukladno članku 13. stavak 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu prijaviti kandidati oba spola.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat/kinja koji/a ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje tog prava, dužan/a je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i rješenje/potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka) te dokaz da je nezaposlen/a (uvjerenje ili evidencijski list Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje). Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17 i 98/19), dužan/a je pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. navedenog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja, na poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu: Dječji vrtić Mali kaj Ivana Gorana Kovačića 13 49000 Krapina (Za natječaj – odgajatelj, NE OTVARAJ) ili osobno u tajništvu u PO Laduč.

Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja će biti pozvani na razgovor (intervju).

jobs.title: Pädagogische Mitarbeiter/in für Auslandsprojekt m/w/d (Erzieher/in - Jugend- und Heimerziehung)
jobs.employer: Nicole Praefke Praefkids Kinder- und Jugendhilfe
jobs.description:
Wir sind ein freier Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe und suchen für ein Auslandsprojekt in Spanien sportlich ambitionierte pädagogische Fachkräfte.

Die Zielgruppe dieses Projektes sind junge Erwachsene Menschen im Alter von 18-21 Jahren, die aus verschiedenen Gründen ihr bisheriges soziales Umfeld verlassen müssen/sollen. In Spanien sollen sie durch 1:1 Betreuung im neuen Umfeld an Tagesstrukturen und neue Abläufe herangeführt werden und mittels sportlicher und schulischer Förderung wieder an die Teilhabe am gesellschaftliche Leben angenähert werden.

Wir suchen für diese Aufgabe Mitarbeiter/innen, die interessiert sind an einem längerfristigen Projekt im Ausland, und die durch ihre sportlichen Ambitionen unser Konzept mit den jungen Menschen mit Leben füllen. Selbstständiges Arbeiten ist bei dieser Tätigkeit eine Grundvoraussetzung.

Die sportlichen Schwerpunkte liegen beim Wasser- und Ballsport und der allgemeinen Fitness.

Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung per Email.

Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten

- Opportunity to grow within the company

- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.
- Excellent communication skills in English.

Desirable:

- Experience with energy system, power system, or electricity market modelling, and with the associated software and programming environments.
- Experience with optimisation, simulation, econometrics, or data analysis applied to energy or market data.
- Knowledge of data centre operations, computing infrastructure, or ICT energy use (Theme B).

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.
 
As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
 
Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS, we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …).
 

Your mission @ Aircall:
  • Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement.
  • Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains.
  • Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams.
  • Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company.
  • Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems.
  • Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
  • Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.
    •  

    A little about you:
  • A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains.
  • You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems.
  • You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains, driving initiatives from ideation to completion.
  • You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives.
  • You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs.
  • You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment.

    • Our Tech Stack:
  • You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Business Partner to serve as the dedicated operational partner to the GM, EMEA. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between the EMEA go-to-market (GTM) organization and Global Revenue Operations (RevOps), owning the operating cadence, surfacing the insights that drive decisions, and turning regional strategy into executable plans.

You'll support the full EMEA GTM motion across Business Development Representative (BDR), Account Executive (AE), Partner Account Manager (PAM), Account Manager (AM), Solutions Engineer (SE), Customer Engineer (CE), and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) functions, spanning four Areas: FIME, UKI, DACH, and Iberia. You'll run the forecast and QBR cadence, own analytics and insights for the region, drive process improvement, and feed regional learnings back into the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, so best practices scale across the business.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who can move fluently between the boardroom and the spreadsheet — equally comfortable facilitating an executive forecast review and building the capacity model underneath it.


What you will do:

  • Act as the trusted operational partner to the GM, EMEA, owning the region's GTM operating model and rhythm of business

  • Run the EMEA forecast process end to end — preparing, facilitating, and following up on weekly forecast calls across the four Areas (FIME, UKI, DACH, Iberia)

  • Own the quarterly business review (QBR) cadence: structure, narrative, data, and readouts for regional and executive audiences

  • Deliver analytics and insights across the full EMEA GTM funnel (BDR, AE, PAM, AM, SE, CE, FDE), translating data into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Lead process improvement initiatives that increase seller productivity, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, providing regional inputs and adopting standardized best practices, tooling, and methodologies

  • Drive annual planning for EMEA, including territory design, segmentation, and capacity/headcount modeling

  • Support quota setting, coverage models, and GTM design in partnership with Sales, Finance, and the broader RevOps team

  • Maintain data quality and operational discipline across the region's systems and reporting


    • What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a comparable analytical/commercial role, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment

  • Strong experience supporting a multi-segment, multi-country GTM organization across direct, partner, and post-sales motions

  • Demonstrated ownership of forecasting, pipeline management, and QBR processes at a regional or business-unit level

  • Excellent analytical skills — fluency with Salesforce and BI/reporting tools (Looker, Hex); comfort building capacity, territory, and segmentation models

  • Experience with annual planning, including territory and quota design

  • Exceptional stakeholder management — credible with senior commercial leaders and able to influence without authority

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills; able to turn complex data into a clear executive narrative

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment

  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) a plus

jobs.title: Ingénieur d'affaires confirmé/Senior Account Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Prise en charge de Key Accounts Français
  • Prospection, développement et suivi d’un portefeuille de clients nationaux, en établissant des plans de comptes, une stratégie commerciale dédiée, et en développant des relations clés
  • Responsabilité d’un quota de vente annuel
  • Conseil et anticipation des besoins des clients et prospects, grâce à votre compréhension de leurs écosystèmes, de leurs métiers, de leurs applications spécifiques et de leurs évolutions
  • Coordination de la définition des solutions techniques requises, en lien avec les équipes techniques française et allemande ; rédaction des propositions commerciales correspondantes (vente et maintenance) dans le respect des politiques tarifaires en place
  • Collaboration avec les équipes de ventes élargies sur les comptes globaux
  • Assurer le reporting avec un forecast précis sur les prévisions de vente
  • Suivi des commandes, de la rédaction des offres et des contrats, jusqu’à la facturation
  • Représentation de la filiale sur des salons, évènements, groupes de travail interne ou externe


Dein Profil

  • Formation supérieure BAC+5, Ecole d’ingénieur ou équivalent universitaire en génie mécanique, mécatronique, ingénierie d’affaire. Double diplôme commercial apprécié
  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans la vente de solutions complexes logicielles et/ou ingénieries, de préférence dans le domaine automobile, avec un historique d’atteintes des objectifs
  • Expérience dans la négociation de contrat pluriannuels et de relationnel haut-niveau
  • Excellent relationnel, orienté client, à l’écoute, curieux et rigoureux, avec un haut niveau d’intégrité et d’autonomie, et qui entretient la bonne humeur et l’esprit d’équipe
  • Attrait technique pour la simulation numérique, et affinité forte pour l’automobile et ses mutations
  • Disponibilité pour de fréquents déplacements en France, permis de conduire français
  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements internationaux occasionnels
  • Français et Anglais courants


Wir bieten

jobs.title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
jobs.description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

MISSIONS

Dans le cadre du développement et de l’amélioration continue de nos processus Supply Chain, vous participerez à l’optimisation des flux physiques et informationnels de l’entreprise. Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur des sujets opérationnels et transverses, en lien avec les équipes Supply Chain et les différents services du site.

Optimisation de la gestion des stocks

  • Participer à la définition et à l’amélioration des méthodes de calcul et de gestion des stocks.
  • Analyser et ajuster les paramètres de gestion : stocks de sécurité, Kanban, flux servitudes, seuils d’approvisionnement, etc.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration du taux de service tout en maîtrisant les niveaux de stocks.
  • Documenter et fiabiliser les méthodes et paramètres de gestion.

Amélioration des flux et de la performance Supply Chain

  • Cartographier et analyser les flux logistiques et physiques.
  • Participer à l’optimisation des implantations et des emplacements de stockage.
  • Déployer des standards visuels et des outils de Visual Management.
  • Identifier les sources de gaspillage et proposer des actions d’amélioration.
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre et la pérennisation des nouvelles pratiques.

Développement des outils de pilotage

  • Vous avez un réel intérêt pour l’amélioration continue et l’optimisation des processus.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse de données et les outils digitaux.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel ; la connaissance de Power BI constitue un plus.

Compétences

  • Capacité à analyser des données, identifier les problématiques et formuler des recommandations.

  • Aptitude à travailler en mode projet et dans un environnement transverse.

Qualités personnelles

  • Vous disposez d’un excellent relationnel et d’une bonne capacité de communication.

Benefits

  • Évoluer sur des projets stratégiques dans le secteur de la défense et des industries de haute technologie.

jobs.title: Mixed-Signal IC Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

jobs.title: OPERADOR DE CENTRAL TELEFÓNICA
jobs.description:
rocuramos um(a) Operador(a) de Call Center para integrar a equipa da SolarTécnica, com responsabilidade pela gestão de chamadas, qualificação de leads e agendamento de visitas comerciais/técnicas.

O perfil deverá apresentar elevada capacidade de comunicação verbal, voz e dicção claras, confiança e profissionalismo no contacto telefónico com clientes. Procuramos uma pessoa comunicativa, resiliente e orientada para objetivos, confortável com uma função em que a realização de chamadas constitui uma atividade central.

É fundamental demonstrar disciplina, organização e capacidade para seguir processos e scripts de contacto, adaptando a abordagem às necessidades e respostas de cada cliente. Deverá também ter capacidade para gerir objeções, manter uma atitude positiva perante a rejeição e assegurar um acompanhamento consistente dos contactos.

Entre as principais responsabilidades estarão: receber e efetuar chamadas; qualificar leads provenientes de diferentes canais; realizar contactos de seguimento e reativação de leads; agendar visitas técnicas e diagnósticos; cumprir as cadências de contacto definidas; e registar de forma rigorosa todas as interações, informações e próximos passos no CRM Bitrix24.

Requisitos: domínio da língua portuguesa, boa capacidade de comunicação, conhecimentos de informática na ótica do utilizador, facilidade na utilização de email, Excel básico e ferramentas CRM. Será valorizada experiência anterior em call center, atendimento telefónico, qualificação de leads ou agendamento comercial, embora não seja obrigatória.

Procuramos uma pessoa responsável, rigorosa, organizada, orientada para resultados, com capacidade de aprendizagem e espírito de equipa, que demonstre compromisso com os objetivos e procedimentos definidos pela empresa.

jobs.title: PINTOR DE CONSTRUÇÕES
jobs.description:
Pretende-se profissional com experiência prática na área da construção civil e reabilitação de edifícios, com especial aptidão para execução de trabalhos em altura através de técnicas de acesso e posicionamento por cordas.

É valorizada formação/certificação específica em trabalhos em altura, rapel profissional e/ou técnicas de acesso por cordas, bem como experiência na utilização de equipamentos de proteção individual, sistemas de ancoragem e demais equipamentos associados à execução segura de trabalhos verticais.

O profissional deverá possuir experiência ou conhecimentos práticos em intervenções de manutenção e reabilitação de fachadas, nomeadamente preparação de superfícies, pintura exterior, tratamento de fissuras, aplicação de argamassas e revestimentos, impermeabilizações e execução de reparações localizadas, recorrendo a técnicas de acesso por cordas sempre que as características da intervenção assim o exijam.

Pretende-se profissional com experiência prévia em trabalhos executados em altura, capacidade de adaptação a diferentes tipos de intervenção e edifícios, domínio e respeito pelos procedimentos de segurança, responsabilidade, assiduidade e capacidade de integração e trabalho em equipa.

O posto implica deslocações entre diferentes obras, predominantemente na região de Lisboa e concelhos limítrofes, devendo o profissional apresentar disponibilidade para o efeito.

jobs.description:
Traži se konobar / ica: 4 radna dana tjedno + osiguran prijevoz u prirodu !
Želite raditi u prekrasnom ambijentu prirode, a pritom imati više vremena za sebe i privatni život? Imamo idealnu priliku za vas!
Za naš restoran u Bio parku Divlje vode tražimo pojačanje – konobara/icu koji/a voli dinamičan rad, srdačan pristup gostima i želi raditi u opuštenoj, ali profesionalnoj sredini.

Što vam nudimo?
•Samo 4 radna dana tjedno – savršen balans posla i slobodnog vremena!
•Osiguran i prijevoz – bez brige o putnim troškovima.
•Rad u prirodi – daleko od gradske gužve, u jedinstvenom ambijentu Žumberka.
•Poticajno radno okruženje i rad u ugodnom timu.

Što očekujemo od vas?
•Pozitivan stav, energiju i osmijeh.
•Profesionalan, ljubazan i ugodan odnos prema gostima.
•Timski duh i snalažljivost u dinamičnim situacijama.
•Poznavanje osnovnih ugostiteljskih procedura i procesa.
•Urednost, odgovornost i pedantnost u radu.

Kako se prijaviti?
Napravite korak prema novom poslu i vrhunskim uvjetima! Prijavite se odmah:
•Putem e-maila ili
•Telefonskim pozivom.
