Job Title: Computer Service Engineer Employer: PC House Limited Location: 12A Frederick Street North, Dublin 1 Annual Salary: €36,605 Hours: 39h per week JOB PURPOSE: To diagnose, repair and maintain laptops, desktop computers and related equipment from different manufacturers, while providing technical assistance to customers. MAIN DUTIES: • Receive customers and obtain information about equipment faults. • Inspect and diagnose problems with laptops, desktops and computer components. • Diagnose and repair motherboards and electronic circuits at component level. • Use oscilloscopes, multimeters, microscopes and other testing equipment. • Analyse circuit diagrams, electrical signals, charging systems and power-management circuits. • Repair or replace faulty components, including screens, batteries, keyboards, connectors, storage devices and memory. • Perform soldering and motherboard rework. • Carry out electrical and load tests and confirm that equipment is working correctly after repair. • Review datasheets and select compatible replacement components. • Install or update BIOS, firmware, operating systems and drivers when required. • Build, configure and upgrade desktop computers. • Identify the causes of recurring faults and develop practical repair and testing procedures. • Explain diagnostic results, repair options and recommended upgrades to customers. • Maintain accurate records of diagnostics, repairs, components and test results. • Train and assist other technicians with advanced repairs and diagnostics. jobs.title: Carpenter
jobs.description:

The carpenter will be responsible for the interior installation, ensuring compliance with HMS procedures, drawings, plans, standards, codes, department instructions, work schedules and quality standards. 

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding.

Tools and working cloth are covered by company. 

So – what are your skills? 


Duties and responsibilities
  • Installation according Vard Interiors standards and guidelines. 
  • Interior work scope could include pinning, insulation of bulkhead and deck, floating floor and/or self-levelling and complete installation of interior areas (e.g. Bathroom modules installation, bottom profiles, walls, ceiling, fix furniture, Window boxes, top covering, etc.)

The Carpenter of Interior shall:

  • plan, schedule and prioritize work for Installation
  • do pre-check of assigned working areas before to start the activities, identify and document, drawings 
  • potential conflicts with other systems and report to Supervisor Interior and Production Coordinator of Interior
  • coordinate operations and anticipately solve any potential installation issue with other
    departments (for ex. hull, paint, electro, piping, hvac etc.)

  • ensure work assigned are completed within defined quality and according to planned schedule
Qualifications

  • Minimum level of spoken English
  • Knowledge of ship interior, build and installation, understanding of schematic drawings
  • Knowledge with Walls and ceiling panels installation, starting from bottom profiles
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience with furniture installation,
  • Ability to read and understand instruction manuals and use of tools

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
  • Must be able to work in team, must be self-driven, reliable, and responsible
  • Good with independent work and coordination with other carpenters
  • Honesty, dependability, compassion, curiosity, ambition, determination, ethical, learns from mistakes, humble, grateful, kind, generous.
Our commitment to you
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Nurmekseen
jobs.description:
**Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Nurmekseen**

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Nurmeksessa. Asiakasta avustetaan kevyissä kodin askareissa ja ulkoilussa.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksi

Lue lisää Hembystä täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Vantaa
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 14,17-16,17 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Er du vores nye højre hånd i den daglige drift?
jobs.description:
Aarhus Rengøringsselskab søger en erfaren tilsynsførende, som både har solid erfaring med rengøring og samtidig har lyst til at tage mere ansvar for kvalitet, medarbejdere og den daglige drift.

Stillingen kan være oplagt for dig, der allerede arbejder som rengøringsassistent eller teamleder, og som er klar til at tage det næste skridt i branchen og skabe dig en karriere inden for rengøring.

Du behøver altså ikke nødvendigvis have arbejdet som tilsynsførende tidligere. Det vigtigste er, at du har en stærk faglig baggrund, tager ansvar og har lyst til at udvikle dig i en rolle med mere koordinering, kvalitetssikring og kontakt til både medarbejdere og kunder.

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og et tæt bindeled mellem medarbejdere, kunder og ledelsen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som tilsynsførende vil du blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Tilsyn og kvalitetssikring hos vores kunder

  • Oplæring og introduktion af nye rengøringsassistenter

  • Opfølgning på medarbejdere og arbejdsopgaver

  • Koordinering ved sygdom, ferie og ændringer i driften

  • Kontakt med kunder omkring den daglige rengøring

  • Kontrol af rengøringsstandarder og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Planlægning og udførelse af forskellige specialopgaver

  • Bestilling og levering af materialer og rengøringsmidler

  • Praktisk deltagelse i rengøringsopgaver, når der er behov for det

Du skal derfor være indstillet på, at jobbet både består af tilsyn, koordinering og praktisk rengøringsarbejde.

Vi leder efter dig, der har erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har praktisk erfaring med almindelig professionel rengøring og ved, hvad god kvalitet betyder i praksis.

Vi ser meget gerne, at du også har erfaring med opgaver som:

  • Grundrengøring

  • Hovedrengøring

  • Flytterengøring af lejligheder og erhverv

  • Gulvbehandling

  • Specialrengøring

  • Brug af rengøringsmaskiner og professionelt udstyr

Har du erfaring med polisharbejde, opskuring og behandling af gulve, er det en klar fordel.

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag, men du skal have en solid faglig forståelse for rengøringsbranchen og lyst til at udvikle dig yderligere.

Måske er du klar til næste skridt?

Du arbejder måske i dag som rengøringsassistent, serviceassistent eller teamleder og kan mærke, at du gerne vil mere.

Måske er du ofte den kollega, andre spørger til råds. Du har styr på kvaliteten, tager ansvar, hjælper nye medarbejdere i gang og har blik for, hvordan opgaverne kan løses bedst muligt.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, kan stillingen som tilsynsførende hos os være dit næste naturlige skridt.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den kandidat med den flotteste titel på CV'et. Vi søger en person med erfaring, faglig stolthed, ansvarsfølelse og lysten til at udvikle sig og skabe en karriere inden for rengøringsbranchen.

Som person forestiller vi os, at du

  • Har naturligt overblik og tager ansvar

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er god til at kommunikere med forskellige mennesker

  • Kan oplære og vejlede medarbejdere på en respektfuld og tydelig måde

  • Har øje for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Er løsningsorienteret og ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Kan bevare roen, når dagens plan pludselig ændrer sig

  • Forstår betydningen af god kundeservice

  • Følger opgaver helt til dørs

Hos os skal en tilsynsførende ikke kun kunne konstatere, at noget ikke er godt nok. Du skal også kunne vise medarbejderen, hvordan opgaven skal løses korrekt.

Praktiske krav

Det er et krav, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen

  • Har kørekort

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller tydelig og øvet engelsk

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider

Det er en fordel, hvis du også kan kommunikere på engelsk, da vi har medarbejdere med forskellige nationaliteter.

Arbejdstid og løn

Arbejdstiden vil som udgangspunkt ligge i dagtimerne.

Da vi arbejder i en branche, hvor opgaver og behov kan opstå uden for almindelig arbejdstid, skal du dog være indstillet på at kunne træde til om aftenen og i weekenderne, når arbejdet kræver det.

Løn aftales individuelt efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du får en stilling med stor variation og mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på den daglige drift.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En selvstændig stilling med ansvar

  • En hverdag med både mennesker, kvalitet og praktiske opgaver

  • Tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

  • Mulighed for at tage næste skridt i din karriere inden for rengøringsbranchen

  • Stor variation i arbejdsdagen

  • Grundig oplæring i vores kunder, medarbejdere og arbejdsgange

  • Mulighed for at blive en central person i virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling

Om Aarhus Rengøringsselskab

Aarhus Rengøringsselskab er en professionel rengøringsvirksomhed med kunder i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi udfører blandt andet almindelig erhvervsrengøring samt forskellige specialopgaver, og vi lægger stor vægt på høj kvalitet, ordentlighed og gode relationer til både kunder og medarbejdere.

Vi tror på, at den bedste kvalitet opstår, når medarbejderne ved, hvad der forventes, får den nødvendige oplæring og har en leder, der følger op og hjælper dem med at lykkes.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV.

Fortæl gerne kort om din erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, hvilke typer rengøringsopgaver du tidligere har arbejdet med, og hvorfor du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Har du erfaring med eksempelvis grundrengøring, flytterengøring, gulvbehandling eller polisharbejde, må du også meget gerne beskrive det.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Aarhus Rengøringsselskab ApS

jobs.title: Autovuokraamovirkailija
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko kartuttaa työkokemusta, josta on sinulle aidosti hyötyä?

Kiinnostaako sinua työskentely autojen parissa?

Koetko asiakaspalvelulähtöisen työskentelyn mielekkääksi?

Mikäli vastauksesi on näihin kysymyksiin kyllä, olisi meillä tarjota sinulle paikkaa kirjavasta joukostamme! Green Motion hakee kasvavan liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin autovuokraamotyöntekijöitä Rovaniemen toimipisteelle tulevaa talvisesonkia varten. Olemme maailman johtava vähäpäästöisten ajoneuvojen vuokraamo. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme mahdollisuuden edulliseen autovuokraukseen unohtamatta ekologisuutta. Työ on monipuolista sekä kartuttaa osaamistasi useilla eri osa-alueilla. Yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen! Työtehtävät koostuvat muun muassa vuokra-autojen siistimisistä ja siirtoajoista aina renkaanvaihtoihin ja useisiin erilaisiin asiakaspalvelutehtäviin asti. Työyhteisömme tarjoaa sinulle työn sesonkiluonteisuudestaan huolimatta rennon ja reilun työilmapiirin. Tavoitteenamme on että töihin on aina kiva tulla, ja työssä viihtyvyyttä tukee myös toimialan kannustavin palkkausmalli! Työaika on sovittavissa tilanteen mukaan niin osa-, kuin kokoaikaiseksi. Olemme työnantajina joustavia, ja pyrimme aina sovittamaan työnkuvasi muuta elämääsi tukevaksi myös työaikojen osalta. Työt sopivat erinomaisesti myös opintojen ohelle sillä työtä tehdään myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin kahdessa eri vuorossa, viikon jokaisena päivänä. Työhön perehdyttäminen toteutetaan ammattilaisten opastamana, joten aiempi kokemus autovuokraamotoiminnasta ei ole välttämättömyys. Katsomme kuitenkin eduksesi, mikäli sinulla on kokemusta asiakaspalvelutehtävistä ja/tai työskentelystä autojen parissa. Tietotekniset taidot sekä kaikki kielitaito katsotaan myös eduksi, sillä asiakaskuntamme koostuu useista eri kansalaisuuksista. Edellytämme sinulta B-ajokorttia, vähintään joko englannin tai suomen kielen sujuvaa puhe- sekä kirjoitustaitoa sekä reipasta ja oma-aloitteista asennetta!

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä vapaamuotoinen työhakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä!

jobs.title: Azure Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
ITCE maakt deel uit van de ConXioN-groep en opereert autonoom. ITCE (IT Centre of Excellence) is een toonaangevende Microsoft Cloud Solutions Partner met ruim 20 jaar ervaring in clouddiensten en IT-ondersteuning. ITCE is gekend om hun vooruitstrevende “Virtual Workplace’ oplossingen.

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van technische ondersteuning en het oplossen van complexe IT-problemen voor onze klanten, zowel remote als ter plaatse. Je beheert dagelijks de ICT-infrastructuur van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat alle technische installaties goed onderhouden en geconfigureerd zijn.

Jouw day to day als Azure Service Desk Engineer:

  • Bieden van remote en on-site IT-ondersteuning, waaronder tweedelijnsondersteuning voor complexere incidenten en aanvragen met betrekking tot hardware en software.
  • Up-to-date houden van de IT-infrastructuur van onze klanten, inclusief installaties en configuraties.
  • Proactief signaleren van technische problemen en bedreigingen.
  • Uitwerken van nieuwe projecten binnen de cloud en optimaliseren van bestaande projecten binnen onze Virtual Workplace-oplossingen.
  • Configureren van Microsoft 365 en Azure omgevingen, en ondersteunen bij de migratie van lokale infrastructuur naar de cloud.

Als Azure Service Desk Engineer werk je oplossingsgericht en servicegericht, en zorg je samen met jouw team voor de beste service aan onze klanten. ️

  • Je hebt al een sterke ervaring met remote en/of on-site troubleshooting en bent bereid je verder te specialiseren.

  • Je beschikt over kennis van Microsoft, Windows Server, Virtualisatie & Networking, Microsoft 365, Azure, TCP/IP networking, switching, routing en VLAN. Behaalde certificaten in één of meerdere van deze gebieden zijn een pluspunt, waaronder AZ-900 Microsoft Azure Fundamentals.

  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en kunt goed samenwerken met zowel klanten als teamleden.

  • Je kan vlot communiceren in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis Frans is geen vereiste, maar zeker een pluspunt.

Als Azure Service Desk Engineer sta je naast de troubleshooting job ook collega’s bij voor technische vragen en help je hen groeien .

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de maintenance en matériels informatiqu (H/F)
jobs.description:
Role Requirements & Responsibilities :

Field Execution and Technical Delivery :
- Attend client sites on time with all required equipment, PPE, documentation, and job readiness.
- Lead complex fibre and copper cabling installations across multi-rack, multi-room, or multi-phase deployments.
- Execute structured cabling tasks including routing, termination, dressing, patching, and cross-connects in live data centre environments.
- Validate job readiness before execution including materials, access approvals, drawings, risk assessments, and site conditions.
- Provide technical input into daily task sequencing and execution planning in coordination with Supervisors.
- Resolve non-standard field issues and implement corrective actions in line with customer standards.
- Ensure all installations follow approved methodologies, design documentation, and safety requirements..

Quality, Testing, and Documentation:
- Validate cable routing, dressing, labeling, and patching accuracy during and after execution.
- Support preparation, execution, and review of fibre and copper testing activities.
- Review test outputs and highlight deviations or quality risks to Supervisors.
- Maintain accurate cable schedules, as-built documentation, and task reporting.
- Identify quality gaps and initiate corrective actions in coordination with Supervisors and Project Leads.

Team Support and Coordination :
- Provide technical guidance and support to field teams during complex tasks.
- Act as technical escalation point for on-site cabling issues.
- Communicate progress, risks, and constraints clearly to Supervisors and Project Leads.
- Represent professionally in all customer-facing site interactions.

Safety and Compliance :
- Ensure compliance with all customer health, safety, and security procedures.
- Identify and escalate safety risks or non-compliant practices immediately.
- Support safety briefings and on-site adherence to operational rules..

The role requires flexibility and adaptability to changing situations and customer requirements, so the candidate must be comfortable working under pressure and on strict timelines. The candidate must be adaptable while performing tasks, ready to change priorities and maintain professional communications with clients, colleagues and vendors.

The successful candidate will be required to possess and demonstrate the following:
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills with high levels of attention to detail.
- Prior experience with the installation of structured cabling including fibre and copper.
- Strong understanding of structured cabling standards, pathways, and installation methodologies.
- Experience working in live data centre environments.
- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record where travel is required.
- Basic experience with hand and power tools.
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, and Email.
- Language proficiency at minimum B1 level in English.
- Proficiency in another European language would be advantageous..
The following qualifications, skills and experience would be an advantage.
- Minimum 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in data centre cabling operations.
- Strong troubleshooting capability across fibre, copper, containment, and rack environments.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, patching matrices, and test documentation.
- Demonstrated ability to lead field execution technically without formal line management.
- Experience mentoring junior technicians.
- Ability to travel for work across customer sites.

Join a team that keeps the world's digital infrastructure running. Every project makes a difference !

jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAISIO

TulemeillekausityöntekijäksijoulusesonkiinTurunOsuuskauppaan
MeTOK:llasanomme tekevämme ihan tavallisia töitä, ja työt joulusesongissa ovat meillä ihan perus. Meille perusjuttuja nimittäin ovat kunnon perehdytys, kivat työkaverit sekähemohyvät henkilöstöedut.Työtsijoittuvat vaihtelevastimarras-tammikuunvälille, ja työsuhteet ovat määräaikaisia ja osa-aikaisia (kaupan ala 10–25h/vko sekämajoitus- ja ravintola-ala 15–45h/3 vko).

Mihin voit työllistyä meillä joulusesonkiin?

Etsimme myyjiä Loimaan ja Turun alueen Prismoihin, S-market Paraisilleja Mynämäelle, Sokos Wiklundille sekäEmotionRaisio Myllyyn.Tarjoilijoitaja kahvilatyöntekijöitä etsimme hotellien ravintoloihin ja kahviloihin, Raisio Myllyn ravintoloihin, Kulman Kuppilaan sekä Heselle. Voit halutessasi valita useita toimipaikkoja samalla hakulomakkeella.

Keitä me etsimme?

Tehtävät vaihtelevat toimipisteen mukaan, mutta yhdistävä tekijä on asiakaspalvelu, rahastus, yleinen järjestely ja tiimityö.Töissätarvitaan halua auttaa asiakkaita, osaat tarttua toimeen ja hoitaa hommia myös itsenäisesti. Tulet juttuun muiden kanssa ja uskallat kysyä neuvoa, sekä tykkäät tehdä vuorotyötä. Moneen hommaan ei tarvita aiempaa kokemusta, mutta on toki bonusta, jos sitä jo löytyy.

Voit tutustua tarkemmin erilaisiin työtehtäviin osoitteessa Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia – TOK. Sokoksen jaEmotioninkauneudenosastolla eduksi katsomme kosmetologin tutkinnon tai aikaisemman työkokemuksen.

🕛 Töitä tehdään vaihtelevasti arkisin ja viikonloppuisin, aamu-, päivä- ja iltavuoroissa, joissakin paikoissa jopa öisin.Huomioithan, että joulusesongin aikaan työvuorot voivat sijoittua myös aattoihin ja pyhäpäiviin, esimerkiksi jouluun ja uuteen vuoteen.Tarjolla on siis fyysistä vuorotyötä. Toimipaikkojen aukioloajat voit tsekata osoitteestaPalvelut – TOK.

Miksi meille kannattaa hakeajoulusesonkiin?

Useintöitä tehdään rahan takia, mutta työkavereiden takia siellä oikeasti viihdytään. Meillä palkkaus onkaupan- ja majoitus- ja ravitsemisalan työehtosopimuksien mukainen, jolloin palkka määräytyy työtehtävien sekä aiemman työkokemuksen perusteella.Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle.Tsekkaa tehtäväkohtaiset palkkahaarukat alta.

Meille perusjuttu on erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut. Työntekijät saavat S-etukortilla kivaa alennusta. Tämä tarkoittaa ravintoloista –25 % ruoista ja juomista,-15 % meikeistä, -8 % peleistä sekä henkilökuntahintaisia hotellihuoneita.Voidaan vannoa, että näin laajoja etuja et saa mistään muualta.

Tokkilaisetkuuluvat myös kannustepalkkion piiriin, jonka maksimimäärä on jopa 1,20 € / tehty työtunti. Jos työskentelet 20 h/vko sopimustunneilla, kannustepalkkion määrä voi olla jopa yli 90 euroa kuukaudessa.

Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja kaikissaTOK:ntoimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella.

Meillä hakemukset lukee ihka oikea ihminen, joka ei rankaise tekoälyn käytöstä, mutta ei saa myöskään paljoakaan irti, jos AI tekee kaikille identtiset tekstit. jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
jobs.description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l'intégration et l'exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l'énergie, l'industrie, le transport, l'aéronautique et la cybersécurité.

Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d'innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d'affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites.

En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante.***Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance.

* Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l'innovation.

Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l'innovation de l'écosystème spatial.

Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l'Espace. Portées par l'IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens.

Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c'est façonner le futur de l'espace aux côtés d'experts passionnés.

La maitrise de l' anglais professionnel (lu, écrit et parlé) est indispensable.

jobs.title: Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term) (m/f)
jobs.description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership-it's our approach to business and relationships.  We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

jobs.title: Research Facilitator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Research Facilitator

(Valid from 03/09/2026 to 18/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Research Support department

Job Number: UOL08436
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Research support
Expertise: Research & Education Support
Job (internal): Research facilitator
Job Level: level 1

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter

Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

ISIM benefits from the status of a ?Super ManCo? as it has the licenses to manage both UCITS and Alternative Investment Fund (AIF).ISIM oversees Investment funds distributed by ING Group entities.Launched in 2014, ISIM is pursuing its development and its positioning as the Management Company (?ManCo?) of ING Group and is the key tool for Investment fund solutions within the Group.ISIM is looking for a Fund Operation Oversight Officer to reinforce its team.

As a Fund Operation Oversight Officer, you will oversee the activities of the Central Administrations and Depositary Banks of investment funds managed by ISIM. More specifically, you will perform the following controls:

Oversight and controls of delegated functions (Fund Administration, Depositary Bank)

• Perform initial and periodic due diligence on the delegates
• Review and analyse the Key Performance Indicators & Key Risk Indicators of the funds (monthly review/exceptions reports from delegates)
• Review and follow up the cash and asset reconciliations
• Oversee the coordination of the fund corporate life cycle (general meetings of shareholders, board circular resolutions, etc)

• Ensure day-to day monitoring of delegates and follow-up of incidents

Given the size of the team, the Fund Operation Oversight Officer will also have to ensure support/backup with regard to administrative tasks of the ManCo whenever needed.

With more than 60,000 employees, ING operates through an international network and offers a broad range of banking and financial services across numerous markets.In Luxembourg, ING serves private, professional and institutional clients through dedicated teams of banking specialists, benefiting from both local expertise and the resources of an international banking group.

The Marketing Team Lead is responsible for LUNEX's local marketing activities, including demand generation, recruitment marketing, integrated campaigns, digital channels, marketing content and performance measurement. jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager - Luxembourg Market (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.
As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


Your next challenge:

You will be responsible for maintaining the portfolio of existing clients, acquiring and building relationships with new clients and intermediaries from and in Luxembourg. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Wealth Management Luxembourg.
Contribute to the growth strategy and to the development of the value proposition of the bank
Conduct research to identify business opportunities with both existing and new customers
Develop a growth strategy, foster and build both long-term and trustworthy customer relationships
Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads and ensure an excellent after-sales service to guarantee the satisfaction of your customers
Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences) where appropriate to grow your own portfolio
Make use of the internal CRM to keep track on your business development activities


Your skills:

A proven track record in a sales position
A strong network of private customers and financial intermediaries in France
An excellent knowledge of the products and services that Luxembourgish private customers and financial intermediaries based in Luxembourg could require (life insurance, wealth planning solutions, loan financing ..)
Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
A high level of integrity and ethics
A relevant University background in Finance
Fluent in French and English, Luxembourgish and German are seen as an advantage
Strongly client- and results-oriented
Rigorous, organized and methodical in customer approach actions
Motivated to be part of a team
Willing and able to travel

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

Strong understanding of the Luxembourg AML/CFT regulatory environment;
Solid experience with complex KYC files, EDD and financial crime risk assessment;
Fluent Chinese/Mandarin is required, combined with professional proficiency in English;

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
Ability to work independently while interacting effectively with international stakeholders;
Rigorous, pragmatic and business-oriented approach to Compliance.

You will join an international and multicultural organisation offering significant exposure to cross-border activities and complex Compliance matters.

jobs.title: Product Partnerships Manager, Consumer/SMB
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Product Partnerships Manager to own Replit's most important strategic partnerships end-to-end: from identifying the opportunity to shipping the outcome and measuring the impact.

This is a product-focused role where you will work with our consumer technology partners, such as Stripe, Shopify, Google, and the broader connector ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, ecosystem thinking, and deal execution. You'll need to be a serious Replit power user. You'll speak credibly with engineers. You'll negotiate with senior partner stakeholders. And you'll be the person accountable for turning ambiguous ecosystem opportunities into shipped product and business outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop a clear point of view on Replit's partner landscape and build a prioritized pipeline of high-leverage opportunities across consumer tooling, AI tooling, cloud and infrastructure, and payments technology partners.

 - Lead partner conversations from early exploration through joint product thesis, business case, commercial terms, launch plan, and post-launch iteration.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Partner Engineering, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to turn agreements into shipped outcomes.

 - Work directly with Partner Engineers to scope integrations, demos, prototypes, reference apps, and partner enablement assets.

 - Define success metrics before every launch activation: retained usage, apps created, deployments, revenue, partner-sourced users, and use them to decide when to scale, iterate, or sunset a partnership.

 - Build lightweight operating systems: partner scorecards, launch checklists, partner roadmap tracking, and repeatable frameworks for evaluating new opportunities.

 - Represent the partner internally with strong product judgment; inform roadmap changes only when they create clear leverage for Replit users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're probably one of these:

 - A product partnerships or BD person from a developer platform, AI platform, API company, cloud platform, or builder tool.

 - A former PM or founder who can sell and negotiate externally while staying close to the product.

 - A technical ecosystem operator who has shipped integrations, partner programs, or AI-native workflows.

In all cases, you're a builder. You can open Replit and put together a credible demo. You're not expected to write production integration code but you need enough technical depth to scope the work, ask the right questions, and earn trust with engineers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and launching strategic partnerships.

 - Strong product judgment: you can explain why a partnership should or shouldn't influence the roadmap.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, auth, cloud and deployment, databases, LLMs, agents, and developer workflows.

 - Hands-on familiarity with Replit or comparable AI-native developer tools; ability to build credible demos and prototypes.

 - Ability to run an ambiguous, multi-party process from discovery through signed agreement, launch, and measurement.

 - Credibility with both senior external partners and internal engineers.

 - Strong written and verbal communication.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Background in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, API companies, or creative/productivity software.

 - Experience with MCP-style integrations, agent workflows, or AI model/tooling ecosystems.

 - Founder, PM, DevRel, solutions engineering, or technical BD background



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Tööülesanded: Koka abistamine igapäevases köögitöös, tooraine ettevalmistamine, köögiviljade puhastamine ja lõikamine, pooltoodete ning lihtsamate roogade valmistamine. Töökoha ja köögi korrashoid, hügieeninõuete järgimine ning muud köögi igapäevased abitööd. Töö käigus on võimalik õppida juurde ning järk-järgult võtta rohkem vastutust toidu valmistamisel.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume stabiilset tööd väikeses ja sõbralikus kollektiivis ning võimalust areneda koos ettevõttega. Pakume väljaõpet töökohal, toitlustust tööpäeva jooksul ning pikaajalise koostöö võimalust. Huvi korral oleme valmis arutama ka erialase väljaõppe ja kutseeksamiks ettevalmistamise võimalusi õppeasutuses.

Muud nõuded: Ootame kohusetundlikku, töökat ja energilist inimest, kellel on soov õppida ja areneda. Oluline on positiivne suhtumine töösse, valmisolek uusi oskusi omandada ning võime töötada meeskonnas. Varasem töökogemus köögis on eeliseks, kuid ei ole kohustuslik – oluline on soov õppida, areneda ja tööd teha.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

liikuv töö Tallinnas

• oled usaldusväärne ja pead kokkulepetest kinni, • õpid kiirelt ja mõtled kaasa, • sul on hea planeerimisvõime ja loogiline mõtlemine, • omad B-kategooria juhiluba.

jobs.title: Kaugkütte- ja gaasitorustike keevitaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Töö kirjeldus: otsime oma meeskonda kogemustega kaugkütte- ja gaasitorustike keevitajat, kelle peamisteks tööülesanneteks on terastorustike keevitamine, paigaldamine ja remont erinevatel ehitus- ning infrastruktuuriobjektidel.
Töö hõlmab: kaugkütte- ja gaasitorustike keevitamist; terastorustike montaaži ja paigaldust; torustike remondi- ja hooldustöid; tehniliste jooniste ja tööjuhendite järgimist; kvaliteedinõuete ja ohutusreeglite täitmist.

Omalt poolt pakume: Omalt poolt pakume:
stabiilset töösuhet ja konkurentsivõimelist töötasu; kaasaegseid töövahendeid ja tööriideid; võimalust osaleda erialastel koolitustel; sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda; mitmekesiseid ja huvitavaid projekte.

Muud nõuded: Ootused kandidaadile:
TIG-keevituse oskus (141); MMA-keevituse oskus (111); varasem töökogemus torustike keevitajana; tehniliste jooniste lugemise oskus; kohusetundlikkus, täpsus ja hea meeskonnatööoskus; valmisolek töötada erinevatel objektidel (lähetused). Kasuks tuleb: MIG/MAG-keevituse oskus (135/136); gaasilõikuse oskus; plasmalõikuse oskus; kehtivad keevitaja sertifikaadid; B-kategooria juhiload; kogemus kaugkütte-, katalmajade- või gaasitorustike ehitamisel.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Manager -London
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.

You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders.

The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance.

You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA.

 - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development.

 - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover.

 - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion.

 - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows.

 - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization.

 - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership.

 - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities.

 - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions.

 - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices.



SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.

 - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery.

 - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams.

 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions.

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems.

 - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans.

 - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments.

 - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders.

 - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs.
   
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment.

 - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows.

 - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration.

 - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling.

 - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs.

 - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts.

 - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up.

 - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions.
   

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.






IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Provide swift, high-priority support to Premium customers, responding within strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Identify recurring issues and collaborate internally to reduce time-to-resolution.

 - Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

 - Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
