jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

jobs.title: Network & Client Management, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a relationship builder with a passion for driving growth? Management Events is seeking Key Client Managers and Network Growth Managers to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in expanding our network of high-level decision-makers. How do these roles contribute to the company's growth?

As a Key Client Manager, you will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with existing C-suite clients.

As a Network Growth Manager, you will identify and cultivate new relationships with C-suite executives.

In this role, you will:

    Identify and engage with high-level decision-makers in your target market market
    Initiate contact with C-level Executives by phone and on LinkedIn to excite them about our concept
    Demonstrate the value of our service and convince them to become part of our exclusive business network in personal scheduled videocall meetings
    Build strong, long-term relationships with C-level executives
    Learn more about their interests, investments plans and upcoming projects
    Develop and execute strategies to expand our network and build valuable relationships, by knowing your customers key challenges and focus areas
    Contribute to the overall growth and success of Management Events

What We’re Looking For

    1–2 years of client-facing experience in a commercial or B2B environment
    Previous experience with cold calling and building business relationships
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    Strong business acumen and a results-oriented mindset
    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
    Passion for connecting with key industry players and driving business growth
    Proactive and persistent approach to reaching new clients and overcoming challenges
    Fluency in Danish and English

What We Offer

    Performance rewarded: You’ll receive an attractive compensation package with base salary, commission, and an additional starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build your sales pipeline.
    Growth and learning: From day one, you’ll benefit from a four-week onboarding program and continuous coaching through our international ME Academy, ensuring you’re always developing and moving forward in your career.
    Career opportunities across Europe: As we continue to grow, you’ll have the chance to explore international opportunities. With offices in Helsinki, Amsterdam, Antwerp, Copenhagen, Berlin, Stockholm, Kuala Lumpur, and Barcelona, your career can take you anywhere.
    Recharge & Thrive: We care about your well-being and want you to stay energized both inside and outside of work. That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with other wellness benefits. Curious about the details in your location? Ask your recruiter to learn more.
    We win together: Collaboration is our driving force, and every success is shared. That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe.
    Annual company trip: Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting company trip - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations.
    Global Community & Diversity: Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success.

Recruitment Process

    Screening video call with our Recruitment Team.
    First interview with the Hiring Manager.
    Second interview (including a short role-play) with the Team Manager.
    Reference check and/or short personal assessment

Please submit your CV in English.

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
jobs.description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Technically grounded

Structured and organized

-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams

Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success

Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

Join Kaneco – One of Ireland’s Leading Commercial Kitchen Specialists Dublin & Surrounding Areas At Kaneco, we don’t just design and build high-performance commercial kitchens – we create the heart of some of Ireland’s busiest and most iconic food destinations. From Michelin-starred restaurants to global blue-chip companies and leading hotel chains, our work powers the kitchens that keep Ireland cooking. As our Service Department continues to grow, we’re looking for Commercial Catering Engineers to bring their skills, energy, and passion for problem-solving to our team. Why Join Kaneco? Variety Every Day – No two jobs are the same. You may be troubleshooting gas equipment in a hotel one day and fine-tuning ware washing systems in a corporate headquarters the next. Work with a Diverse Client Base – Our customers range from blue-chip companies to restaurants and hotel groups, giving you exposure to the latest technologies and a wide range of industry sectors. A Role Beyond Engineering – This is a customer-facing, field-based position where you will build strong relationships and represent a company recognised for expertise and quality service. Opportunities for Growth – As our service department continues to expand, you will have the chance to develop your skills and progress within the business. Key Responsibilities Service, maintenance, and breakdown repair of commercial gas and electric kitchen equipment. Carrying out planned preventive maintenance in line with client requirements. Installation, testing, and commissioning of a wide range of catering equipment. Applying a problem-solving and solutions-based approach to ensure business continuity in fast-paced environments. Managing daily workload independently and completing reporting via mobile device. Ensuring full compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations on site. Supporting colleagues by sharing knowledge and experience with other engineers, apprentices, and non-technical staff. What We Offer Company vehicle provided. Company mobile phone Full uniform and PPE supplied Tools provided Opportunities for overtime Manufacturer-led training Comprehensive training and professional development Flexible working hours Salary commensurate with experience

jobs.title: Work flexibly, earn extra - Join Imercos Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary job in November and December, with the opportunity to earn extra money and gain valuable work experience? Do you enjoy being physically active and working at a fast pace? Then now is the time to seize the opportunity!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4 shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

On a typical working day, you will pack approximately 100–150 boxes, depending on the size of the orders.

We expect you to:

  • Enjoy routine-based and independent work

  • Have a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for your shifts

  • Be physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the day

  • Have good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Be available for 4 shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Be available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We also offer an exciting temporary position in a well-established and busy retail company, where you will become part of a strong team with great team spirit. You will have the opportunity to work morning, evening, or night shifts, while earning extra money during the busy season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour. In addition, evening, night, and weekend supplements are provided.

Employment terms

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application.

Employer: LBR Elad Limited Number of Positions: 1 Hours of Work: 42 hours per week / 84 hours per fortnight Minimum Annual Remuneration: €35,210 per annum Start Date: On or after 1st December 2026 About Inclusive Living: Inclusive Living provides residential support to adults with complex needs, including intellectual and physical disabilities, autism and acquired brain injuries. Our service is rights-based, neuroaffirmative and trauma-informed. We promote independence, protect individuals and uphold integrity through safe, respectful and person-centred support. Job Description We are seeking compassionate and dedicated Healthcare Assistants to join our adult disability residential services in Galway. The successful candidates will support adults with complex needs in a safe, respectful and empowering residential environment, helping each person to take part in daily routines, community life and activities that reflect their individual interests, abilities and choices. Main Duties and Responsibilities: The role includes supporting residents with daily living, personal care, meals, routines and community participation; promoting dignity, privacy, independence and personal choice; assisting with person-centred plans, care plans, risk assessments and communication supports; encouraging positive routines, social inclusion and meaningful activity; attending appointments where required; contributing to reviews and meetings; building positive professional relationships with residents, families, colleagues and external professionals; reporting concerns or changes in wellbeing; maintaining accurate records; and following all safeguarding, health and safety, infection prevention, medication management and confidentiality procedures. Skills and Competencies Required: Candidates must be able to demonstrate experience supporting vulnerable individuals; promote person-centred care, dignity, respect and independence; communicate clearly and professionally; work effectively as part of a team; build positive relationships; remain calm and resilient in a busy care environment; follow policies, procedures and care plans; work independently when required; and use relevant IT systems for records and communication. Qualifications and Experience Required: Candidates must have a QQI/FETAC Level 5 qualification in Healthcare Support, Social Care or a related field, or an equivalent or higher qualification. Previous experience in healthcare, disability services, residential care or social care is desirable. A full driving licence is desirable but not essential. The successful candidates will be required to complete Garda vetting and any required pre-employment checks before commencement.

jobs.title: Chefs for the Parliament Restaurant at Christiansborg Palace
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about great food and looking to use your culinary skills in a kitchen where no two days are the same? Would you like to work in a unique environment that combines historic surroundings, high ambitions, and a vibrant atmosphere?

At Christiansborg Palace, home of the Danish Parliament, every day brings new experiences. We follow the rhythm of parliamentary life, where meetings, conferences, official events, and political activities create a workplace full of energy, variety, and opportunities to grow.

A Workplace Defined by Quality, Variety, and Team Spirit

At Christiansborg, we prepare daily lunch and dinner services, operate cafés, and provide catering for events of all sizes.

On busy days, we can serve up to 1,200 guests across the Parliament's restaurants, cafés, and event venues. During elections, major political events, and special occasions, the pace increases and priorities can change quickly. This creates a dynamic and exciting working environment where flexibility and teamwork are essential.

You will become part of a team of more than 20 colleagues, including chefs, kitchen staff, waiters, and service professionals who work closely together to achieve a common goal: delivering outstanding dining experiences for our guests every single day.

Your Responsibilities

  • Preparing hot and cold dishes with a focus on quality, flavour, and seasonal ingredients

  • Producing catering for conferences, receptions, and special events

  • Contributing ideas for menu planning, with a strong focus on reducing food waste

  • Providing friendly and professional service to guests

  • Supporting smooth kitchen operations and assisting where needed

  • Working with food safety procedures, hygiene standards, and daily quality controls

Working Hours

Working hours are scheduled between 06:00 and 21:00 and will be agreed upon individually.

Evening and weekend shifts will occur in connection with events and special functions.

Who Are You?

You are a trained chef with experience from a staff restaurant, catering operation, large-scale kitchen, restaurant, or a similar environment. Above all, you have a genuine passion for food and enjoy working in a fast-paced and varied setting.

In addition, we are looking for someone who:

  • Works in a structured and responsible manner

  • Has a strong eye for quality, detail, and the overall guest experience

  • Is welcoming, service-minded, and professional when interacting with guests

  • Remains calm and adaptable when priorities change

  • Has a positive attitude towards teamwork and enjoys finding solutions rather than obstacles

What We Offer

  • A permanent full-time position (37 hours per week)

  • A strong and supportive team culture with skilled and dedicated colleagues

  • An exciting and varied working day in one of Denmark's most vibrant institutions

  • The support and opportunities of Compass Group, including professional and personal development

  • Attractive employment terms covered by a collective agreement, including pension scheme, flexible benefits savings programme, healthcare plan, and employee discounts

We are looking for new colleagues to join us as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Ready to Join the Team?

Send us your CV today.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

Important Information

Please note that all employees working at Christiansborg Palace must be able to obtain the required security clearance.

And will be a part of all oure units

jobs.title: Norwegian speaking insurance sales agent
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge yourself and are you comfortable with some healthy competition? Are you fluent in Norwegian?
- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling and advising on insurance solutions for existing customers in the financial sector.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.


Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales from a previous job
 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.

- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

 

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to contact us.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.

211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

jobs.title: Dynamics 365 F&O Developer
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Build the financial engine behind global sustainable impact

 

Do you want to build and evolve the financial technology platform that enables investments — from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to play a pivotal technical role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A central role in evolving our Dynamics 365 F&O platform

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders in a friendly, inclusive culture

  • Access to the full Microsoft enterprise stack in a modern, tech-driven environment

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

Please note:

  • This position operates out of our main office in Copenhagen, and regular presence at the office is required. 

  • While we welcome applications and are open to candidates from outside of Denmark, please note that Impact Fund Denmark will not provide relocation assistance.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. We challenge each other, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that make a real difference across the organisation. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our D365 F&O platform

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer to take a key role in developing, customising, and maintaining the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform that underpins our financial operations and reporting globally. You will work closely with our Solution Architect, Business Application Manager, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

 

You will, for example:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy customisations and extensions in Dynamics 365 F&O

  • Integrate D365 F&O with other systems in our stack, including Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and third-party SaaS applications

  • Configure and optimise financial modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, and Budgeting

  • Collaborate with the Solution Architect to align development work with our enterprise architecture principles and integration patterns

  • Participate in and contribute to requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical designs and functional specifications

  • Support and maintain existing D365 F&O configurations, data entities, and custom solutions — and troubleshoot issues as they arise

  • Contribute to DevOpsSec practices, including ALM, source control, release management, and deployment pipelines

  • Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge transfer within the team

 

You bring deep F&O expertise and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Dynamics 365 F&O development and configuration, you understand how to turn complex financial requirements into well-engineered solutions that stand the test of time.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Have solid hands-on experience developing in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

  • Are comfortable configuring core financial modules and translating business processes into D365 workflows

  • Have experience with integration patterns and tools, such as Data Entities, OData, Logic Apps, or Azure Integration Services

  • Understand the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and how it connects to F&O

  • Are familiar with Lifecycle Services (LCS), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices for D365

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders — bridging the technical and functional worlds

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector or international development finance

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve. You will work with:

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)

  • Microsoft Fabric & Azure Data Services

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

  • Several fit-for-purpose SaaS solutions and integrations

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's Development Finance Institution. We aim to be a best-in-class impact investor by making commercial private sector investments that support the green transition, as well as building just and inclusive societies in developing countries and emerging markets. Impact Fund Denmark has a strong focus on creating sustainable and responsible businesses, which generate measurable social, economic, and climate impacts as well as solid financial returns.

 

Ready to build the financial engine behind global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:

  • Platform development: design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application

  • Web application development: design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs

  • Dynamics 365 configuration: configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence

  • Process automation: build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems

  • Backlog delivery: work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release

  • Requirements translation: engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs

  • Collaboration with external resources: coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase

  • Testing and release: support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation

  • Production support: troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use

  • Documentation: maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

 

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Technical foundation: have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Platform expertise: have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate

  • Web development skills: have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code

  • Dynamics 365 knowledge: understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles

  • Collaborative delivery: are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers

  • Communication: communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments

  • Problem-solving: take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application

  • Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform

  • Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications

  • Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus

  • Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve, with a growing web application layer alongside it. As Power Apps & Web Application Developer, you will work with:

  • Microsoft Dataverse (our core data platform for this application)

  • Microsoft Power Apps (model-driven and canvas apps)

  • Microsoft Power Automate

  • JavaScript and Node.js for custom web application and API development

  • Dynamics 365 as a platform (excluding functionality requiring a Dynamics 365 Sales licence)

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), as an integrated neighbouring system

  • Azure DevOps for backlog, source control, and release management

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A focused, hands-on role with real ownership of a growing, business-critical platform

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

Ready to build the backbone of our investment, risk and finance operations?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

job@naka.dk

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

jobs.title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

jobs.title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

• Be keen to learn from your employers.

jobs.title: Cohort 0
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication: Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Self-driving Company https://replit.com/blog/self-driving-company

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
   
    

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

 - Operating Principles https://blog.replit.com/operating-principles

 - Reasons not to work at Replit https://blog.replit.com/reasons-not-to-join-replit

jobs.title: OUTRO TRABALHADOR DE LIMPEZA MANUAL
jobs.description:
O grupo francês Saur International, referência na gestão sustentável da água, reforçou a sua presença em Portugal com a aquisição da CTGA e Enviman através da Aquapor, consolidando a sua posição de liderança em Portugal, apostando em soluções inovadoras nas áreas da engenharia hidráulica, sanitária e ambiental.

Junte-se a uma equipa sólida, com visão de futuro, e contribua para projetos que fazem a diferença.
Procuramos um Técnico Operativo de Desobstrução e Limpeza (m/f) para a Zona de Lisboa, destacando-se:

Principais responsabilidades:
- Condução das viaturas hidroaspiradoras;
- Transporte de lamas;
- Desobstrução de fossas;
- Trabalho conjunto com os Operadores de Infraestruturas de Água e Águas Residuais para limpeza das infraestruturas.

Requisitos Exigidos:
